narrative.northStar: The Marked Paper, Under Deep Water
narrative.overview: Abyss is the current Lemely brand direction: a cool, precise, deep-blue identity that explains every mark. Scope: marketing portal only; the authenticated app still consumes the legacy Study Notebook tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Cool and exact: neutrals tinted toward hue 240.
One action color (Abyss); Tide is its dark-surface counterpart.
Heavy tightly tracked display type against a calm grotesque body.
Flat tonal layering by default; one soft blue shadow for floating artifacts.
Clip Letters wordmark with upright paperclips.
One signature easing, short motion, fully off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Dark-Surface Swap Rule
rules.body: On Night or Abyss backgrounds, accent roles move from Abyss to Tide. Abyss text or icons on a dark surface are forbidden.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Gold, green, and red each carry one meaning (reward, correct, lost marks). Never decoration.

rules.name: The Cool Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every gray is tinted toward hue 240 (Night toward 264).

rules.name: The Heavy Display Rule
rules.body: Bricolage is always 800 with negative tracking and used at 28px or larger.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Bricolage 800, -0.04em, line-height 0.82, lowercase; clips upright, stroke 5, round caps.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, and chips are flat at rest; only floating product artifacts take the shadow.

rules.name: The Tilted Plate Rule
rules.body: The hero artifact sits on a Mist Wash plate rotated -2.5deg; the only decorative rotation besides the photo stack and Binny poses.

dos: Do use Abyss (#042f4f) for action on light surfaces and Tide (#7fb8e0) for the same role on Night or Abyss surfaces.
Do set display type in Bricolage Grotesque 800 with -0.03em to -0.05em tracking, at 28px or larger.
Do keep every neutral tinted toward hue 240, and reserve Gold, Green, and Red for reward, correct, and lost marks.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion with fully static fallbacks.
Do keep these tokens inside .marketing-brand; app screens keep their own legacy tokens.
donts: Don't apply Abyss tokens, Bricolage/Schibsted fonts, or these radii to authenticated app screens.
Don't use Academic/institutional aesthetics: "Times New Roman, university portal grays, government-form layouts."
Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard look: "navy blue hero, metric cards with gradient shadows, the HubSpot/Salesforce template."
Don't drift into consumer edtech gamification: "Duolingo-style emojis-as-UI, confetti, bright primary colours, cheerleader copy."
Don't produce "The 'AI product' look: purple-blue gradients, dark glassmorphic panels, neon accents on near-black."
Don't build "Cookie-cutter card grids and dense bootstrap-coloured dashboards".
Don't use Abyss as text or icon color on dark surfaces.
Don't tilt the wordmark clips or set the wordmark below 20px height.
